title: Vocation
introduction: ‘Vocation’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects different kinds of work, respect for workers, childhood imagination, daily occupations, dignity of labour. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
